stem:
Mitali keeps dry moong seeds in a jar. Later she soaks some on moist cotton and they sprout.

What is the best way to classify a seed?

options.text: A living seed will germinate even when water, air, and warmth are unsuitable.
A seed can be classed with living things: under suitable conditions it germinates and grows.
A wooden pencil is living because it came from a plant that grew from a seed.
A dry seed that has not yet sprouted must be non-living.

teacher.key_rationale: Seeds are living: given suitable conditions they germinate and grow.
